translations.translatedText: # Thursday 29.9.2022 (radio)

Finland closes the border to Russian tourists. Finland has strengthened the security of the Balticconnector gas pipeline. Corona infections are rising again. The Bank of Finland has its doors open. Friday's weather.
## Russian visas

![Russian cars wait to enter Finland at the border between Russia and Finland.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5349,h_3008,x_0,y_183/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1012383632ee1b1314ec/1664165085)
Open image viewer
Russian cars wait to enter Finland at the Vaalimaa border station. Photo: Sasu Mäkinen / Lehtikuva
Finland is restricting the arrival of Russian tourists to Finland.
From tomorrow Russian tourists will no longer be able to enter Finland if the sole purpose of the trip is holidaying or travelling through Finland to other countries.
Family members or relatives can still visit each other. People can also cross the border, for example, for work or study.
After the new restrictions, traffic at the eastern border may decrease to perhaps half of the current level.
The government justifies the tightening of the restrictions by the endangering of international relations.
## Balticconnector

![Graphic shows on a map the routes of the Nord Stream 1 and 2 and Balticconnector gas pipelines.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1919,h_1080,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-101383063343a7d4ddcb/1664367266)
Open image viewer
The Balticconnector pipeline brings gas to Finland from the Baltic countries. Photo: Samuli Huttunen / Yle

Finance Minister Annika Saarikko says that the security measures for the Balticconnector gas pipeline have been strengthened. Gas comes to Finland from the Baltic countries through the Baltic Connector pipeline.

Security measures have been strengthened because of the Nord Stream gas pipeline leaks. A total of 4 leaks have been found in the Nord Stream gas pipelines. It is suspected that Russia caused the leaks on purpose.
## Corona infections
![Young person in a face mask at a bus stop.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11628225)
Open image viewer
WHO again recommends the use of face masks, especially on public transport. Photo: Tiina Jutila / Yle
The number of corona cases has turned to growth during the autumn.
The Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare says that towards winter the number of infections will probably continue to grow.
The growth in infections is also visible in health care. In hospitals there are now 340 patients because of corona disease.
Booster vaccinations are given to people over 65 and to people who belong to risk groups. Healthy people do not need extra vaccinations.
The World Health Organization (WHO) recommends the use of face masks in the European region, especially on public transport and indoors where there are many people.
## Bank of Finland's doors open
![Snellman statue in front of the Bank of Finland.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_2472,h_1391,x_0,y_112/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6686595ea6e8fc70cab/1587997073)
Open image viewer
In front of the Bank of Finland is the statue of J.V. Snellman. Photo: Matti Myller / Yle
The Bank of Finland is opening its doors to the public. The Bank of Finland's main building in Helsinki's Kruununhaka is open to the public from today until Saturday.
In the Bank of Finland's ceremonial and representative premises Finnish art is on display. About 1,200 works of art are on show. In addition, information on money and cyber security is available.
The last time the Bank of Finland opened its doors to the public was in May 2018.
## Friday's weather
![Finland weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12644108)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
On Friday it rains in places in the southern and central parts of the country. In the north it sleets.
The temperature in the north is under 5 degrees and elsewhere in Finland between 5 and 10 degrees.
